affected_system: roadway, bridge, sidewalk, signal, and public right-of-way asset network
alternatives: rank verified high-consequence candidates for road and bridge maintenance and renewal portfolio
select a risk-, equity-, and lifecycle-balanced portfolio for road and bridge maintenance and renewal portfolio
pair condition, consequence, access, lifecycle cost, and deliverability optimization with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Assets, inspections, defects, work orders, costs, traffic, restrictions, and completion are reconciled.
Engineering thresholds and deterioration models are locally reviewed and versioned.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: fund only already-committed work for road and bridge maintenance and renewal portfolio.

constraints.description: The road and bridge asset management prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: public works asset manager and chief infrastructure engineer
decision_question: Which preventive, rehabilitative, safety, accessibility, and replacement projects should be funded?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The road and bridge asset management prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
independence_key.decision_object: road and bridge maintenance and renewal portfolio
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for road and bridge maintenance and renewal portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: condition, consequence, access, lifecycle cost, and deliverability optimization

intended_claim: A versioned prioritize design for comparing declared alternatives affecting road and bridge maintenance and renewal portfolio, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in expected risk-adjusted deficient asset-years
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report request-based prioritization as engineering design, capital approval, or completed work.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.
reference_implementation_note: Tier-D template deep.infrastructure.maintenance-portfolio.v1 (Infrastructure-maintenance request portfolio) supplies a bounded reference workflow for this design axis. The mapping does not establish complete city-specific inputs, external validity, deployment, adoption, or impact.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for road and bridge maintenance and renewal portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.

title: Prioritize road and bridge maintenance and renewal
transportability_risks: Materials, climate, loading, standards, inspection, procurement, and unit costs differ.
Service requests can reveal workload but not structural condition or safety.
